title: The measure θHⁿ⌞M: finite on compacts, same null sets as Hⁿ⌞M, and weighted tangent planes are tangent planes with multiplicity θ(x)
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M : Set (Rn N)) (θ : Rn N → ℝ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)), NullMeasurableSet M μHE[n] → IsPositiveLocallyIntegrableWeight n M θ → μ = ((μHE[n] : Measure (Rn N)).restrict M).withDensity (fun z ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (θ z)) → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) ∧ (∀ S : Set (Rn N), μ S = 0 ↔ μHE[n] (M ∩ S) = 0) ∧ ∀ (x : Rn N) (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x P → HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P (θ x)
